subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

The __board__ will look into the matter.

options.text: A group of members of a company

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "A group of members of a company".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"board"** refers to a group of individuals who manage or oversee the operations and decision-making of a company, organization, or institution. (परिषद, प्रबंधन मंडल)

 
 
• **Example:** The board decided to increase the company’s investment in renewable energy projects.
 
 
 
• The correct meaning of the word "board" in the given context is a "group of members of a company" (कंपनी के सदस्यों का समूह). This refers to the governing body that looks into and makes decisions about important matters related to the organization.
 
 
• **Example:** The board of directors approved the annual budget for the next fiscal year.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of "board" in this context matches Option 3.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A union of workers** (मज़दूर संघ): A group of employees who come together to advocate for their rights and interests in the workplace.

 
 
• **Example:** The union of workers organized a strike to demand better wages.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: A member of a family** (परिवार का सदस्य): An individual belonging to a family unit.
 
 
• **Example:** Every member of the family contributed to the preparation for the festival.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: A group of elected politicians** (चुने हुए राजनेताओं का समूह): Refers to a governing or legislative body made up of elected officials.
 
 
• **Example:** The group of elected politicians discussed the new policy reforms in the parliament.
